body: Lens 1 - all measurements reproduce. Two git flags cross-tested for independence across six throwaway repositories against a no-probe control: each disarms exactly one hazard, neither disarms the other's. changed = 2 porcelain entries for 4 changed files. Five code citations resolve to the exact lines claimed; the document's SECURITY.md citation is correct where DEC-3's own is off by one line.

Lens 2 - bounds match the DRC-4122 amendment character-for-character on the nullable surface and name session_ended rather than the finished_at turn-stop stamp. Zero occurrences of twice, unconditional, or finished_at. All seven elements present and nothing beyond them, evidenced against quota-fetch-security-scope.md recovered from 7134a01. Escalation trigger not met.

Eight acceptance criteria reproduced from their own Verified by clauses. AC2 proven from the aggregator mechanism rather than from the report: a skipped job passes only when the detector said code=false, and the gate refuses to report at all if the detector did not succeed. All three runs verified by API to carry head 9d9059f. Copilot: zero inline comments, zero reviews, none requested.

Arbiter reproduced finding 1 rather than ranking it. CODEX_EVENTS at event_hook.py:160 carries no SessionEnd mapping; codex-hooks.json registers none; agy_hook.py emits only store_changed and says so in its own comment; only event_hook.py:82 and :200 produce session_ended. Eight of ten rows can never be probed, not six. Classification needs-decision: the text is the captain's amendment verbatim and the error runs conservative.

reason: GO. No material finding. Four recorded, none blocking, all routed rather than fixed. Nothing edited by the review stage and no commit made on the PR branch.

Send back, fix the rewording, re-verify, then merge. Accepts the direction; one concrete ask on doc line 46, which understated how little coverage the probe has and is promoted into SECURITY.md verbatim. Two constraints: no harness name list and no hard count, and DRC-4122's amendment text is unchanged.

body: Correction applied. Evidence reproduced independently rather than taken from the gate. Both constraints honoured: the replacement states the property - the probe fires on session_ended, most harnesses do not emit it, so most rows carry null - with no names and no count. Head 00444a7, one path, 102 added, 0 removed, mergeStateStatus CLEAN, checks green.

reason: Correction round 1 closed as delivered. The single authorized ask was applied and nothing else moved: one path, 102 added, 0 removed, validator exit 0, checks green on head 00444a7, mergeStateStatus CLEAN. Both constraints held - no harness name list and no hard count, so the wording cannot go stale inside a verbatim-promoted section - and every item on the do-not-change list is untouched, including the fsmonitor wording that carries no run count and is therefore correct under both observed hook behaviours. This closes the round only; it applies no gate decision. The reviewer re-runs on the corrected state and the gate is re-entered from that verdict.
